background.title: Reserve Bank of India
background.extract: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) is the central bank of the Republic of India and the regulatory organisation for the Indian banking & financial system and Indian currency. It is owned by the Ministry of Finance, Government of India, it is responsible for the control, issue, and supply of the Indian rupee. It also manages the country's main payment systems & the foreign exchange under the FEMA Act, 1999. The RBI is a statutory body of the union government and considered State under the Article 12 of the Constitution of India.

places.title: India
places.extract: India, officially the Republic of India, is a country in South Asia. It is the world's seventh-largest country by area and its most populous. Bounded by the Indian Ocean on the south, the Arabian Sea on the southwest, and the Bay of Bengal on the southeast, it shares land borders with Pakistan to the west, China, Nepal, and Bhutan to the north, and Bangladesh and Myanmar to the east. In the Indian Ocean, India is near Sri Lanka and the Maldives.
